description: Implementation of RegistrationClientFactory for creating and managing RegistrationClient instances within the Hono client framework, including cache management and event handling for tenant timeouts.

classes.name: RegistrationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing RegistrationClient instances, handling connection events, caching, and tenant timeout events.

methods.name: RegistrationClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a HonoConnection and optional cache provider, setting up event bus consumer for tenant timeout.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Clears the registration client cache upon disconnection.

methods.name: getOrCreateRegistrationClient
methods.description: Returns a Future for creating or retrieving a RegistrationClient for a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: removeRegistrationClient
methods.description: Removes a RegistrationClient associated with a tenant ID from the cache.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing the corresponding RegistrationClient.
